meta.name: ultrawork
meta.description: The binding ultrawork-mode directive. This file IS the directive; read it only when ultrawork mode is requested and the directive is not already in the conversation.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 开启高强度模式,让助手更专注彻底地完成任务
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果希望助手在特定任务上切换到更专注、更彻底的工作方式
copy.tagline_en: Turn on a high-intensity mode so the assistant finishes tasks more thoroughly
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want the assistant in a more focused, thorough mode for a task

howto.what: 切进 ultrawork 模式后，Claude 首行固定打印 ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED!，先用 create_goal 登记目标与成功标准，开 notepad 持续记录，用 todo 逐条推进，并在真实界面（curl、浏览器、终端等）跑验证留存证据。
howto.when: 当你要求进入 ultrawork 模式时触发；原文说明只有该模式被请求、且对话里还没有这份指令时才读取本文件。

howto.what_en: Once triggered, Claude enters ultrawork mode: it prints ULTRAWORK MODE ENABLED! first, registers a goal and success criteria via create_goal, keeps an append-only notepad, tracks steps with todo, and captures real-surface QA evidence.
